_units.message_count: count of messages in the session
_units.part_count: count of content parts (text, reasoning, tool calls)
_units.user_request_count: count of user messages in the session
_units.thinking_length: sum of reasoning part text length in characters (not tokens)
_units.tokens_input: model input tokens (count, not characters or time)
_units.tokens_output: model output tokens (count, not characters or time)
_units.tokens_reasoning: model reasoning tokens (count, not characters or time)
_units.durations.total_seconds: active time in seconds: AI processing + user activity (idle time NOT counted)
_units.durations.ai_processing_seconds: actual AI processing time in seconds (sum of per-message time.created to time.completed)
_units.durations.ai_processing_count: count of assistant messages with valid time.created and time.completed
_units.durations.user_activity_seconds: total estimated user activity time (input phase + output phase)
_units.durations.user_input_phase_seconds: time spent writing prompts and waiting for output
_units.durations.user_output_phase_seconds: time spent reviewing AI output and verifying changes
_units.durations.user_writing_seconds: tier-based estimate of prompt writing time (see session-stats-units.md for tier table)
_units.durations.user_waiting_seconds: fixed time per prompt for system acceptance and initial check
_units.durations.user_review_seconds: estimated time spent reviewing AI responses
_units.durations.user_verification_seconds: fixed time per prompt when files were modified
_units.durations.user_word_total: total word count across all user requests in session
_units.durations.user_word_distribution: count of user requests by word count tier
_units.durations.user_request_count: number of user prompts in session
_notes: tokens_* are COUNTS of model tokens processed, not time or character counts
1 token ≈ 4 characters in English text on average
thinking_length is in CHARACTERS of reasoning text (sum of reasoning part text lengths)
durations do NOT include idle time between prompts (overnight, breaks, etc.)
user_writing_seconds is an estimate since actual typing time is not tracked by the AI assistant
user_writing_seconds uses word-count tiers (15s / 60s / 180s / 360s / 600s) — see session-stats-units.md
user_waiting_seconds is 8 seconds per prompt (3s acceptance + 5s initial check)
user_verification_seconds is 60 seconds per prompt when files were modified
